meta.method_note: Income tax for 2026-27 from GOV.UK 'Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances'; employee National Insurance from HMRC 'Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027' (annual figures). The allowance falls by £1 for every £2 of income above the taper threshold, as GOV.UK states. Each figure equals the committed ETL edition named in its source (etl/sources/govuk_tax_rates.py), which checks the two documents against each other. National Insurance applies across the UK; Scotland sets its own income tax bands. The thresholds are frozen until April 2031 (Budget 2025).

sources.title: GOV.UK, Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances
